captureBoundaries: Binary bytes must match pinned Git blob object ID, length-derived object framing and any bound SHA256; Git file/directory aliases are resolved and authenticated without consulting host topology.
Captured binary blobs have private own inodes and SHA256 deduplication. The complete private hardlink set is checked so host-linked cache entries cannot be accepted as private.
Installed node_modules bytes are copied once with a separately accepted physical-tree digest. A Git-authenticated package-lock is bound; installed bytes are not falsely called Git source contents.
Captured dependencies preserve internal symlinks and executable flags; external/dangling/cyclic links and special files reject. openat traversal does not follow source-parent symlinks.
Both roots and asset forests use private inputs. Host worktree is hidden; readonly Git object storage is explicitly restored. Only declared per-run outputs and temporary directories are writable.

External preparation SHA256 is required by launcher; a shared exclusive lock prevents concurrent materialization/extension and producer runs. Private asset/dependency/hardlink checks run before and after the command.
The original materializer keeps a full pinned private Git index while only selected input bytes are physical. Candidate projections retain separate inodes and exact kernel inverse/hash checks.
Historical host-mounted roots cannot be silently upgraded through --extend. Existing A80 roots and all frozen A/schema/verifier bytes remain untouched.

tests.syntheticMaterializerBoundary: A tiny actual Git commit with one identity projection, binary assets, private dependencies and a selected subset/full index is exercised. This calls the materializer boundary, not a synthetic full Source-A authority.

profileBoundary: Current Source-A remains the frozen v1 proof on5c9. Root/Astra are preparing exact relocation of seven audit artifacts into existing qa-artifacts classification; this step does not change any profile or apply that relocation.
remainingBeforeFullQa: Mechanical seven-artifact archival and new exact current Source-A proof per Root order.
Identity-only Kind/A/M/V joins with actual original validation and original fingerprints; no D/P adapter as native inputs are unchanged.
Math-Duration-policy original repair and any independently justified technical binding transport; no generic hash rewrite.
Freeze actual complete selected input/read closure, explicitly bind all remaining runtime/tool inputs, audit candidate reads including relative/FD-relative paths and closed directory discovery.
Run genuine original/candidate producers and capture all actual results; this component test is not full physical candidate-QA or a floor/M6/M7 pass.
